title: Przetrwamy
caption: Polish cold wave band, post-punk with rock guitars and analog electronics, chorus-drenched clean and distorted electric guitars, melodic driving bass guitar, live drums layered with a drum machine, analog synthesizers, anthemic emotional post-punk, tom-heavy drums, chiming guitars, rising synths, soaring guitar solo, quiet bridge building to a triumphant climax with a soaring high female voice, guitars ringing out. Vocals: young adult male lead vocal in his late twenties, raspy sharp strained grunge voice like Kurt Cobain, cracking on high notes; young adult female lead vocal in her late twenties, deep low contralto, calm, gloomy, cold and intimate; young adult female vocal in her twenties, high clear airy soprano, sharp, crystalline and ethereal; deep warm male bass voice humming like a distant monk choir far in the background. raw live band recording, high fidelity, natural vocals, no autotune, in tune, clear Polish diction
lyrics:
[Intro - tom-heavy drums, chiming guitars, rising synth]

Przetrwamy
